name: NLP4LP
description: Write a Python solve(question, llm) agent that, using a budgeted OpenRouter model client and optionally local numpy/scipy code, returns the optimal objective value of an NLP4LP optimization word problem; scored by accuracy within 1e-3*max(1, |optimum|) on a fixed 30-problem sample of the 178 cleaned problems (higher is better).

sources.locator: benchmark cleaning used by EvoOR-Agent (its reference [48])

requirements.hardware: See upstream requirements and task notes.

commands.notes: Population initialization. Model-driven search: requires LLM API credentials and incurs cost; never run by seed checks.

Multi-generational co-evolution and evaluation over the bundled OR datasets; the pinned release bundles no NLP4LP data and its evaluate.py does not select it, so this command does not evaluate NLP4LP. Model-driven search: requires LLM API credentials and incurs cost; never run by seed checks.

limitations: The inspected paper links no readable official repository; the official release was identified separately and is pinned (see below).
Paper-provided anonymous code URL https://anonymous.4open.science/r/pL8xY2mQ8rA5fC3vB7nK could not be read: web tool inaccessible; direct HTTPS connection reset. No downloadable artifact verified.

Official EvoOR-Agent release pinned; the LLM configuration is anonymized in the release, and the release bundles the BWOR, IndustryOR, MAMO and NL4OPT data, selected inside evaluate.py (NLP4LP and ReSocratic are not included).
Execution interface inspected in pinned source. Full paper experiments have not been reproduced here.
